install: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; case "$(uname -m)" in x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;; aarch64|arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/bazelisk" ]; then curl -fsSL -o "$HOME/.local/bin/bazelisk" "https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazelisk/releases/download/v1.28.1/bazelisk-linux-${ARCH}"; chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/bazelisk"; fi; ln -sfn "$HOME/.local/bin/bazelisk" "$HOME/.local/bin/bazel"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/buildifier" ]; then curl -fsSL -o "$HOME/.local/bin/buildifier" "https://github.com/bazelbuild/buildtools/releases/download/v6.4.0/buildifier-linux-${ARCH}"; chmod +x "$HOME/.local/bin/buildifier"; fi; if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends libnghttp2-dev python3-dev shellcheck; fi; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; if [ -f /etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts ]; then grep -qxF 'startup --host_jvm_args=-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=/etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts' "$HOME/.bazelrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'startup --host_jvm_args=-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore=/etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts' >> "$HOME/.bazelrc"; grep -qxF 'startup --host_jvm_args=-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=changeit' "$HOME/.bazelrc" 2>/dev/null || echo 'startup --host_jvm_args=-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStorePassword=changeit' >> "$HOME/.bazelrc"; fi; "$HOME/.local/bin/bazel" --version
